subject: Important Reminder: Evacuation when fire alarm is activated
body: Dear all MOS residents, When you hear the fire alarm bell ringing and see the flashing lights shining inside your hall, please take the following steps to evacuate immediately: 1. EVACUATE using the nearest fire exits. DO NOT use lift. 2. GO DOWNWARD and leave the building. 3. PROCEED to the designated assembly point (i.e. the open space outside the Student Residence Office). Please view a short video 'Fire Safety Tips You Should Know'. As the MOS' fire service system is currently connected to the Ma On Shan Fire Station as a statutory requirement, upon arrival, the Fire Services Officers will: 1. investigate the root cause of the activated fire alarm, for example, a real fire, a break glass unit broken by someone, the detector triggered or other reasons. 2. confirm whether the situation is safe. Afterwards, SRO and the authorized security personnel will announce that the residents are safe to return to the hall and rooms. According to the building design, please note that: - No Public Address (PA) system was built inside halls. It is only available at the Sports Hall. - The fire alarm coverage is divided into 5 zones, i.e. 1) Hall 12/13, 2) Hall 14/15, 3) Hall 16, 4) Hall 17, and 5) Other areas including Sports Hall and the Podium. In this regard, the fire alarm will be activated at particular zone instead of the Compound. Thank you for your kind attention. Student Residence Office 5 November 2026

subject: Reminder: Learning Outcome Questionnaire (LOQ) for Semester A 2026/27
body: Dear Student, Learning Outcome Questionnaire (LOQ) - Your response matters! You are invited to fill out the Learning Outcome Questionnaire (LOQ) distributed to you via the LOQ System. The LOQ is an 11-question survey devised to collect students' feedback. Your completion of the LOQ will also help the University continuously improve learning and teaching and inform personnel decisions. Please CLICK HERE now to complete the questionnaire(s) to share with us your views. Your response truly matters! Please note the following when completing the questionnaires: 1. Please use your standard CityUHK EID and password to log into the LOQ System (which also supports mobile devices). 2. "Teacher" in the questionnaire broadly refers to the one who leads the section you are giving your evaluation. "Teacher" can be a lecturer, tutor, teaching assistant, speaker, trainer, mentor, as similar. 3. If a course is taught by multiple teachers, you may receive multiple questionnaires. Please complete the questionnaire for each teacher. The names of the teachers for the sections under evaluation are displayed on the top of each questionnaire. 4. Your questionnaire responses, once collected, will be kept strictly confidential and no personally identifiable information will be revealed. 5. The completion of questionnaires is completely on voluntary basis, yet we value your accurate overview of the quality of learning and teaching experience. Please therefore complete the questionnaires with great care, and complete them only if you believe that you have sufficient knowledge of the course and the teacher. Do share with us your valuable opinions! 6. ACT now! It is inappropriate for any individual to try to influence your responses to questions in the questionnaire. Please report any such actions to the Office of the Provost and Deputy President at eval@cityu.edu.hk. If you have any problems with the LOQ System, you may refer to the Online User Guide, or contact us at eval@cityu.edu.hk. For more details about the LOQ, please visit our website at https://go.cityu.hk/loq/. Thank you! Professor [NAME], Associate Provost (Quality Assurance and Accountability)
